headline: Federal Reserve Expected to Resume Interest Rate Increases in December
summary: Federal Reserve officials are expected to restart rate increases in December, with the pace of additional policy moves remaining dependent on incoming economic data.
why: The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States, managing monetary policy that influences global borrowing costs and asset prices.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Expectations of higher interest rates increase corporate borrowing costs and reduce equity valuations.

why_moved: Anticipation of additional central bank rate hikes generally elevates treasury yields and weighs on risk assets.
